scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --prefix admin && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.predev: npm run kill && npm run db:init && npm run usb:reverse
scripts.dev: wt -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run dev:server" ; split-pane -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run usb:mobile" ; split-pane -H -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.predev:wifi: npm run kill && npm run db:init
scripts.dev:wifi: wt -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run dev:server" ; split-pane -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run dev:mobile" ; split-pane -H -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.tunnel: wt -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run dev:server" ; split-pane -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run tunnel:mobile"
scripts.admin: wt -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run dev:server" ; split-pane -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.preusb: npm run db:init && npm run usb:reverse
scripts.usb: wt -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run dev:server" ; split-pane -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run usb:mobile"
